description: Eawag publishes surveillance-camera videos of the floodX experiments at the Wangen urban flooding testbed in Switzerland. The deposit groups video archives by camera and recording session and supplies estimated temporal offsets in a separate text file. These offsets allow visual records to be related to sensor readings from the same experiments. Zenodo offers the TAR packages publicly and free under CC0-1.0. The inspected listing includes sessions in October 2016; the metadata does not specify the complete period or frame rate. A limitation is that estimated clock corrections and camera perspective affect comparisons of visible flood fronts with calculated water levels. The videos can support visual validation of urban inundation simulations and development of camera-based monitoring. They complement the floodX sensor tables with spatial observations of flooding. No videos were downloaded, played or transformed during this review.
